statement_alignment: Ordinary local p-adic Koenigs/Schroder analytic germs. Over Q3, H=x/(1-x/3) linearizes F=3x/(1+2x/3) on norm x<1/3, with H derivative1, F multiplier3, an invariant attracting neighborhood and actual orbit convergence. Its actual convergent power series has rational a0=0 and a(n+1)=3^(-n), so the actual reduced denominator of a3=1/9 is9, contradicting the necessary first-power-only bound. No integral-input, polynomial-input or fixed unit-disc condition occurs in either language.

Proves coefficient uniqueness for H, not uniqueness of all normalized Schroder germs or a general Koenigs theorem.
